scenes.heading: Alert detected
scenes.description: A monitoring alert enters OpsAgent through Slack or Gmail.

scenes.heading: Agent acknowledges
scenes.description: The Monitoring Agent acknowledges the incident and identifies the affected resource.

scenes.heading: Investigation begins
scenes.description: OpsAgent collects server, service, network and recent-change evidence.

scenes.heading: Root cause explained
scenes.description: The agent summarizes the likely cause, impact and recommended remediation.

scenes.heading: Human approval
scenes.description: A guarded operation is prepared and waits for an authorized approver.

scenes.heading: Resolved and communicated
scenes.description: The operation completes, evidence is audited, and Slack and Gmail are updated.
